act: Public Sector Pension Investment Board Act
subject: Reappointment of a director of the Public Sector Pension Investment Board and her designation as Chairperson of the Public Sector Pension Investment Board
precis: Reappointment of Maryse Bertrand of Westmount, Quebec, as a director of the Public Sector Pension Investment Board, for a term of three years; and redesignates her as Chairperson of the Public Sector Pension Investment Board, effective December 16, 2026.
